name: dg-baseline
why: What most DG Roam proofs assume, without a database: sync and node sharing off (so a PR's CI build can run it, for anyone), advanced node search on, the four default node types, one page per default type, and a quiet UI. A kit that needs the database turns sync or sharing on in its own prepare and says needs: supabase; it then runs against the proof database.

prepare.why: the sync flag (Suggestive mode overlay enabled) is off, so DG doesn't connect to a database when it loads
node sharing is off, so DG doesn't connect to a database when it loads
advanced node search is on, so DG: Open Node Search is registered
one page per default node type exists

check.js: ['[[CLM]] - PK baseline claim', '[[QUE]] - PK baseline question', '@PK baseline source', '[[EVD]] - PK baseline evidence - [[@PK baseline source]]'].every((title) => proof.page.exists(title))

apply.js: (async () => { for (const title of ['[[CLM]] - PK baseline claim', '[[QUE]] - PK baseline question', '@PK baseline source', '[[EVD]] - PK baseline evidence - [[@PK baseline source]]']) { await proof.page.ensure(title, ['Baseline page for proof kits. Leave it in place.']); } })()

prepare.why: no dialog, toast or right-sidebar window is left over from the load

expect.js: proof.assert(typeof (window.roamjs && window.roamjs.extension && window.roamjs.extension.queryBuilder && window.roamjs.extension.queryBuilder.runQuery) === 'function', 'The DG extension did not load.')

smoke.title: The four default node types exist

expect.js: (() => { const labels = proof.nodeTypes().map((node) => node.text); const missing = ['Claim', 'Question', 'Evidence', 'Source'].filter((label) => !labels.includes(label)); proof.assert(missing.length === 0, 'Missing node types: ' + missing.join(', ') + '. Found: ' + labels.join(', ')); })()

smoke.title: The baseline flags read back: node search on, sync and sharing off

expect.js: (() => { const wrong = [['Advanced node search enabled', true], ['Suggestive mode overlay enabled', false], ['Enable node sharing', false]].filter(([name, value]) => proof.flags.get(name) !== value).map(([name]) => name); proof.assert(wrong.length === 0, 'These flags are the wrong way round: ' + wrong.join(', ')); })()

smoke.title: Discourse settings open from the command palette

expect.js: proof.assert(proof.dialogs().length === 0, 'A dialog is still open after closing settings.')
